changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedGroup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionDeletedGroup]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [GroupUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionDeletedGroup] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Uid] ASC ) ) END
